integrity: The proof derives the new off-diagonal entry directly from the unique positive-diagonal QR factorization, identifies the exact best coordinate permutation, and optimizes the resulting factor over every orientation at fixed spectral condition number. Exact rational witnesses establish growth, contraction after swapping, and sharp equality. The checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic one-step theorem for real 2x2 SPD matrices under unshifted QR with positive R diagonal. It does not classify shifted QR, dimensions three and higher, nonsymmetric matrices, global iteration counts, or the diagonal eigenvalue-estimation metric used in the permutation paper.
title: Sharp one-step off-diagonal law for permuted two-dimensional QR iteration
